title: Dynamic K-Head: Difficulty-Supervised Budget Selection for Continuous Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17679v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning but incurs substantial autoregressive rationale cost. Continuous CoT moves intermediate computation into recurrent hidden states, yet typically uses a fixed number of updates even though the best budget varies across questions and accuracy need not improve monotonically with $K$. We introduce Dynamic K-Head, a question-conditioned, pre-rollout budget selector. It is jointly trained with the reasoner under selected budgets, using difficulty supervision based on scores assigned from the question alone. We also show that latent-update count can misrepresent end-to-end cost because a short latent rollout can shift computation into a longer explicit continuation. We therefore count latent updates, implementation-specific special tokens, and all decoded text. Instantiated with CoDI on Llama 3.2 1B and GSM8K, Dynamic K-Head reaches 54.44% exact-match accuracy at 12.03 average reasoning/output tokens,

translated_title: 动态K头：面向连续潜空间推理的难度监督预算选择
translated_abstract: 思维链提升了推理能力，但会产生大量的自回归推理步骤成本。连续思维链将中间计算转移到循环隐状态中，但通常使用固定数量的更新次数，尽管最优预算因问题而异，且准确率并不一定随K单调提升。我们提出了Dynamic K-Head，一个基于问题条件、在推理生成前进行预算选择的机制。它与推理器在选定预算下联合训练，使用仅基于问题本身评分的难度监督信号。我们还表明，潜空间更新次数可能会错误地反映端到端成本，因为较短的潜空间展开可能将计算转移到更长的显式续写中。因此，我们同时统计潜空间更新次数、实现特定的特殊标记以及所有解码的文本。在Llama 3.2 1B模型和GSM8K数据集上以CoDI实例化后，Dynamic K-Head在平均12.03个推理/输出token下达到54.44%的精确匹配准确率。
tldr: Dynamic K-Head根据问题难度自适应地为连续潜空间推理选择最优更新预算，以极少的token消耗实现了高准确率的推理。
en_tdlr: Dynamic K-Head adaptively selects the optimal update budget for continuous latent reasoning based on question difficulty, achieving high reasoning accuracy with minimal token consumption.
